- agents.md:4993 | severity=NIT | confidence=4
  PROBLEM: The clause "its merge-train release scan uses its own event's base, so if the PR was retargeted between the closes, PRs queued on the former base wait for the next scheduled sweep" states the delay as unconditional.
  WHY: `cancel-in-progress: false` in `.github/workflows/cancel_on_pr_close.yml` (lines 19–20 of the PR diff) means an already-started earlier close run is not replaced. It runs its release scan with its own `BASE_BRANCH`, so the former base's queued PRs are released by that run and do not wait for the sweep. Only a still-pending earlier run is dropped.

  WHY: With `cancel-in-progress: false`, an already-running earlier close run continues when a newer same-PR close run is queued. That run uses its own event's `BASE_BRANCH` and can release queued PRs on the former base before the scheduled sweep.
